notes: Modeled on the standard (non-Dante) EM 6000, the base SKU. The optional "EM 6000 Dante" variant (with Audinate Brooklyn II card) replaces/adds two Amphenol RJ-45 ports labeled Primary/Secondary for Dante audio networking (redundant or daisy-chain), in addition to the control Ethernet port described here — that variant was not modeled separately. AES3 digital output connector is XLR-3; no bandwidth "grade" was set on it because AES3 is not one of the connector types with a defined grade scale in the schema (sdi/hdmi/dp/usb/eth only) -- omitted per instructions despite the field being populated in a draft; treat as informational only, not a valid grade value. Word clock BNC ports are 75 ohm (distinct impedance from the 50 ohm antenna BNCs) but the schema has no separate connector id for that, so "bnc" was used for both. Frequency range/RF band (470-714 MHz US variant) and channel count (2) are not part of the port list. Physical rear-panel print labels (e.g. exact "OUT 1"/"AES3"/"WC" text) are inferred from Sennheiser's official online manual/spec pages rather than a photograph of the chassis; wording may differ slightly from the silkscreen.
